$comment: Record properties Inkwell reads or preserves that the pinned Standard.site Lexicons do not declare.
Hand-authored; tools/lexicons/update-standard-site.mjs reads this file but never rewrites it.
Every entry is a deliberate decision that needed writing down somewhere: without it, a fixture
carrying one of these fields would look like schema drift, and a reader would have no way to tell
'the Lexicon grew a field we haven't modelled yet' apart from 'publishers emit this and always have'.
`modelledBy` records which clients have a typed property for it; an empty list means the field only
survives via the non-destructive edit merge path, never through a typed model.

theme.note: Rich Leaflet-style per-document theme override. Emitted by Leaflet-family publishers and cascaded by both readers, but absent from the published site.standard.document Lexicon.

preferences.note: Per-document display toggles (showComments/showMentions/showRecommends/showPrevNext/showInDiscover). site.standard.publication declares a #preferences def; the document Lexicon does not, so this is an extension on both platforms -- iOS does not model it at all.

canonicalUrl.note: Absolute document URL, emitted by Standard.site's own publisher. Inkwell derives the canonical URL from site + path instead, so nothing reads this; it must still survive an edit untouched.

theme.note: Rich Leaflet-style publication theme. The Lexicon declares only basicTheme; the reader theme cascade is Leaflet theme -> basicTheme -> system.

createdAt.note: Emitted by Standard.site's own publisher on publication records. Not declared by the Lexicon and not read by Inkwell.
